description: Hosted zones list console match + full Create hosted zone page. Rework /hosted-zones to match the real console chrome while preserving all existing CRUD, then add the full /hosted-zones/create page (with all pinned exact strings, radio type cards, Tags container) wired to api.createZone, and delete CreateZoneModal. Depends on FEAT-001 (uses the new icons, .btn--create, .helper-line, .icon-btn classes). The create payload and types are already correct in lib/api.ts and lib/types.ts — do NOT change them.
steps: Edit c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\hosted-zones\page.tsx: remove showCreate state, the CreateZoneModal import, and the {showCreate && <CreateZoneModal/>} block. Put the live count in the title (`Hosted zones ({total})`). Header-right order: circular refresh icon-btn (calls load()), secondary View details / Edit / Delete (disabled until a row selected — keep existing selection logic), then primary outlined-orange `Create hosted zone` as a Link to /hosted-zones/create (className 'btn btn--create'). Add the helper line (.helper-line) with EXACT text 'Automatic mode is the current search behavior optimized for best filter results.' followed by a blue link 'To change modes go to settings.' Change the filter input placeholder to EXACT 'Filter records by property or value'. Add a settings gear icon-btn in the toolbar beside the existing real Pagination. Columns in order: Hosted zone name (sortable), Type (sortable), Created by (PLAIN non-sortable header, render z.created_by), Record count, Description, Hosted zone ID. Empty state: heading 'No hosted zones', subtext EXACT 'There are no hosted zones created for this account.' plus a 'Create hosted zone' Link to /hosted-zones/create. Keep EditZoneModal, ConfirmDeleteModal, search debounce, sort(name/type), and Pagination wiring unchanged.

Create c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\hosted-zones\create\page.tsx ("use client"). State: name, type ('Public'|'Private' default 'Public'), comment, submitting, error. Hooks: useRouter, useFlash. Breadcrumb items [{label:'Route 53',href:'/hosted-zones'},{label:'Hosted zones',href:'/hosted-zones'},{label:'Create hosted zone'}] + a header row with

Create hosted zone

and far-right Info + share icon-buttons (visual-only). A .container-box titled 'Hosted zone configuration' with the pinned subtext and three fields using the EXACT pinned strings from design.md section 'Pinned UI strings (create hosted zone full page)': Domain name (label + InfoLink; helper 'This is the name of the domain that you want to route traffic for.'; input placeholder 'example.com'; the exact valid-characters hint line below); Description - optional (label + InfoLink; helper 'This value lets you distinguish hosted zones that have the same name.'; textarea placeholder 'The hosted zone is used for...' with maxLength={256}; live counter 'The description can have up to 256 characters. {comment.length}/256'); Type (label + InfoLink; helper 'The type indicates whether you want to route traffic on the internet or in an Amazon VPC.'; two .radio-card cards side by side — Public default .radio-card--selected with title 'Public hosted zone' / desc 'A public hosted zone determines how traffic is routed on the internet.', and Private with title 'Private hosted zone' / desc 'A private hosted zone determines how traffic is routed within an Amazon VPC.', each with a radio input).

In the same create page add a separate .container-box titled 'Tags' with Info, subtext 'Apply tags to hosted zones to help organize and identify them.', the text 'No tags associated with the resource.', a visual-only 'Add new tag' button (onClick no-op), and static text 'You can add up to 50 more tags.' Then a .form-actions footer row bottom-right: Cancel (btn--link, router.push('/hosted-zones')) and outlined-orange 'Create hosted zone' (btn btn--create).

Implement the create submit handler mirroring the old modal: trim name; if empty set inline error 'Domain name is required.' and abort (no API call); else setSubmitting(true), call api.createZone({ name: name.trim(), type, comment }); on success flash.success(`Hosted zone ${zone.name} created successfully.`) then router.push('/hosted-zones'); on failure show (err as Error).message inline and stay on the page; always clear submitting.
Delete c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\components\CreateZoneModal.tsx (only used by hosted-zones/page.tsx, whose import was removed in step 1).

/hosted-zones/create renders the configuration container with all pinned helper/placeholder strings, a working {n}/256 counter, two radio cards (Public default-selected), the Tags container, and Cancel + outlined-orange Create hosted zone; submitting a valid name creates a zone via api.createZone, fires the success flashbar, and lands on /hosted-zones with the new zone listed; an empty name shows the inline 'Domain name is required.' error with no API call.
components/CreateZoneModal.tsx no longer exists and nothing imports it; zone edit and delete still work via their existing modals.
